request.prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the fambaa. Fambaas were large herbivorous amphibians most often found in swamps, with the scaly hide of reptiles, and were used as beasts of burden. Body plan: a huge, low-slung swamp amphibian with reptile-scaled hide and a broad, heavy back built for hauling loads. A short, thick neck is carried forward and only slightly raised, so the broad heavy head projects forward at about shoulder height, like a big lizard grazing. The lower jaw carries a short pale tusk on each side near the front of the mouth, jutting upward past the upper lip, clearly visible from the front and in side profile. A long, thick-based, tapering scaly tail extends from the rump: in side view it trails straight out behind the hips, in rear view, seen from behind, it hangs down visibly between the haunches, and it turns consistently with the body on every facing. Colouring: the whole back, upper flanks, neck and head are olive-khaki to greenish-tan, with darker olive mottling across the scales; the throat, belly, undersides and inner legs are paler grey-cream. The olive-khaki back and flanks are the dominant colour on every facing: front view, side view and rear view alike. A frilled crest along the head and neck in a deeper olive shade of the same hide colour. Keep the body shape, scaled hide, broad back, tusks, tail and frilled crest as in the previous render; only the hide colour changes. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, clean dark outline, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible including the full tail, nothing cut off. Fully transparent background with only the creature drawn.
